尽量缩短思考时间: Keep reasoning time to a minimum
填写模型 ID 后自动识别思考能力。: Enter a model ID to detect reasoning support.
填写服务地址后自动识别思考能力。: Enter a service address to detect reasoning support.
暂时无法识别思考能力，可重试或手动设置。: Unable to detect reasoning support. Retry or set it manually.
模型目录未收录这个 ID；确认服务支持后，可以手动开启。: This ID is not in the model catalog. Enable reasoning manually if your service supports it.
模型目录标记为不支持思考强度。: The model catalog does not list reasoning support.
由模型决定思考方式: Let the model decide how to reason
由模型决定，无需设置。: The model decides; no adjustment is needed.
使用该模型的默认思考强度: Uses this model’s default reasoning effort
思考强度随模型设置: Reasoning effort follows the model settings
声明模型是否支持思考；实际开关与强度在下方设置。: Declare reasoning capability here; configure request controls below.
按当前渠道配置；支持思考不代表支持所有档位。: Configure for this provider. Reasoning capability does not imply support for every effort level.
尚未识别控制方式；不发送思考参数，也不声称已关闭。: Controls are unknown. No reasoning parameter will be sent; this does not mean reasoning is off.
兼容 OpenAI 的地址也可能使用不同的思考参数。: OpenAI-compatible endpoints can use different reasoning parameters.
思考与正文共享输出上限，至少为正文留出 1024 tokens。: Reasoning shares the output limit with the answer. Reserve at least 1,024 tokens for the answer.
初始值是编辑模板。只勾选渠道实际支持的档位；相同参数值只保留一档。: Initial values are a template. Select only supported levels, with one level per distinct parameter value.
例如 none；不填或省略参数不能代表关闭。: For example, none. An omitted parameter does not mean off.
选择思考的深入程度，也可在会话中调整。: Choose how deeply to reason. You can also change it in a conversation.
本次强度由最后一条消息级设置决定；此前设置保留历史，顶层值用于缓存。: The last message-level setting controls this call. Earlier settings preserve history; the top-level value is the cache baseline.
尚未生成实际请求参数。: Request parameters have not been generated yet.
旧记录仅包含 SDK 选项，无法确认实际发送的思考参数。: This older record contains SDK options only; the actual reasoning parameters cannot be confirmed.
未识别项可根据服务说明手动补充。: Fill in unknown capabilities using the provider’s documentation.
